physicalSpanRegistration.interpretation: Report upstream-to-downstream direction is promoted onto a physical span route only when source pipe material/nominal size, exact 3D node tips, connectivity, and report length agree within 0.25 ft. Flexible terminals use the source fitting identity and exact rigid-port/sprinkler endpoints; an unexported hose centerline is never fabricated.
